artworks.title: Maria Klementyna Sobieska
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman seated with one arm resting on a surface and the other raised near her shoulder. She has an oval face, arched eyebrows, and full lips. Her hair is styled in curls with a feather and a hairpiece. She is wearing a patterned gown with lace trim and puffed sleeves, adorned with decorative elements. There is fur beside her and a crown on the surface. The background has a textured oval within a stone-like border.

artworks.title: Gisbert Flüggen
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an illustration of a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly left with his head turned towards the viewer, making direct eye contact. The man has a strong brow, deep-set eyes, a mustache, and a slight beard. His medium-length, wavy hair looks unkempt, falling over his forehead. He is wearing a double-breasted coat with a high collar. The background is plain and neutral, highlighting the man. Below the drawing are signature details and notes, including handwritten text and an artist's signature.

artworks.title: Vidi, quod aperuisset agnus... (The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse)
artworks.medium: pen and ink over chalk on wove paper back with Asian paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four muscular figures on horseback in dynamic poses. The central figure holds a bow with one arm outstretched, while the horses below them are also in motion. The background shows swirling clouds. The drawing emphasizes musculature and anatomical detail.

artworks.title: A Female Nude Seated on a Ledge
artworks.medium: red chalk with white heightening on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a seated person who is partially nude. They are positioned with one arm extended upwards, grasping a pole or structure, while their legs are bent at the knees. Their head is tilted slightly upward and to the side, with their eyes closed. The facial features are detailed, showing a strong jawline and full lips, with short, curly hair framing the face. The person is not wearing any clothing. The focus is on the contours and musculature of their body. The background is simple, with flowing lines suggesting drapery or fabric. There are no visible objects or jewelry in the image, and the background appears plain, with minimal shading and details.

artworks.title: Head of a Bearded Gentleman
artworks.medium: black chalk with white heightening on blue paper
artworks.description: This is a charcoal drawing showing a side profile view of a man's head and upper torso. The man is positioned with his back slightly turned towards the viewer, looking to the right. He has a prominent nose, a thick beard, and wavy hair falling around his head. The man is wearing a shirt with loose fabric. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is plain, and there is a faint signature in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: A Bearded Gentleman with a Glass of Wine
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a three-quarter view of an individual with a focus on their upper body. The person is standing in a slightly turned position, holding a glass in their right hand raised to shoulder height. Their face is roughly sketched without distinct features. The hair is outlined without specific details. The person is depicted in a long overcoat with a high collar and a jacket with slightly visible sleeves. The drawing is in pencil on textured, light-brown paper. The background is blank.

artworks.title: Head and Hand of a Man Throwing Dice
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on blue-gray paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of an older man's head and a partial view of his right hand. The man's face is turned to the left, looking upwards. He has a broad forehead, thinning hair, pronounced eyebrows, and sideburns that reach his jawline. His expression is calm and thoughtful. The sketch indicates he may be holding a small object or pointing with his index finger. He is wearing a garment with a high collar, but details are not shown. The background is plain to keep the focus on the man.

artworks.title: A Reliquary of Saint Sigismondo
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a radiant figure in a heavenly setting. The image shows a grand throne-like structure with an arch, decorated intricately. At the top center is a figure emanating light, seated upon clouds, holding onto an object. Below this figure, there is a group of seated figures in dynamic poses. They appear to be interacting in a harmonious manner. The scene is encased in an ornately decorated frame, filled with flowing patterns and acanthus leaf designs, emphasizing grandeur and spiritual elevation.

artworks.title: Trompe l'Oeil: A Curlew Hanging from a Nail
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over black chalk
artworks.description: A bird is shown hanging upside down by its feet, secured with a blue ribbon against a wooden panel with an arched top. The bird is white with brown speckles and dark brown and grey feathers on its wings. The background consists of soft beige and brown tones, with the bird displaying white, brown, grey, and black colors. The bird is centered on the wooden panel, facing downward, with its wings partially open to either side, casting a shadow on the panel.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Family
artworks.medium: daguerreotype
artworks.description: The image is a Victorian-era family portrait featuring four members. The father is seated in the center, while the mother stands to his left holding a young child's hand. A young boy stands to the father's right. The father has styled hair with sideburns and wears a suit with a bow tie. The mother has a center-parted hairstyle and wears a dress with lace-trimmed shoulders. The standing boy wears a dark suit with a bow tie, and the young child is dressed in a puffy-sleeved dress. The family is adorned with a large brooch worn by the mother. The background is plain and dark, and the image is housed in an ornate frame with a decorative border.

artworks.title: Elliot Marbles
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows an inscribed stone slab with lines of text in an ancient script. The stone is light in color, possibly sandstone, with multiple rows of neatly arranged text covering its surface. The script is detailed and rounded, typical of historical scripts. A measuring scale is above the stone for reference. The stone's surface is slightly rough with some irregularities, indicating age and good preservation.

artworks.title: Beekinpully: Permaul’s Swing at Mariammah Covil
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows a view across an open area bordered by large trees. There are hills in the distance above scattered structures. The picture has a soft, grainy texture giving it a vintage appearance. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. Large shadowed trees frame the composition, with small huts and a tall wooden structure visible in the distance.

artworks.title: The Tuileries Gardens
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in green on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of six figures standing closely together. They are facing forward and wearing various types of headwear. One figure is bowing and holding onto another's leg. The figures are surrounded by a railing, with outlines of leaves in the upper left corner. In the background, there are sketchy outlines of smaller figures against a wall or large formation. The image is done in a single color.

artworks.title: A Potted Fuchsia with Children's Toys
artworks.medium: watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a potted plant with white and pink flowers on a wooden table. The colors include dark green leaves, pink and white flowers, a gray pot, and brown tones from the table and background. In the foreground, there is a blue cloth and some loose petals on the table's edge. Additionally, a ball and two shuttlecocks are visible on the left side of the table.

artworks.title: A Seascape at Sunset
artworks.medium: pastel
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 40.5 x 57 cm (15 15/16 x 22 7/16 in.) (measured through frame)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Hermen and Monica Greenberg Foundation in honor of Monica Lind Greenberg
artworks.description: The image shows a maritime scene with sailboats on a calm body of water. The horizon line is positioned one-third from the top of the canvas. Several sailboats are on the horizon against a sunset sky of soft blues, oranges, and pinks. The water below reflects the sky's colors. The largest sailboat is on the right side in the distance, with smaller boats on the left. The color palette is subdued and harmonious, emphasizing the interaction between sky and sea.

artworks.title: Quarterdeck of HMS “Impregnable”
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: The Sarah and William L Walton Fund, Diana and Mallory Walker Fund and Robert B. Menschel Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a ship's deck with wooden planks leading towards the mast in the center. The horizon is not visible due to the low angle of view. The composition includes the mast, rigging lines, and parts of the superstructure. The sepia-toned photograph has a vintage feel with a monochromatic color palette of warm brown shades. Figures are scattered across the deck, engaged in various activities, appearing small compared to the large structures around them. Rope coils and small lifeboats line the deck's edges.

artworks.title: Darien Harbor, Chipigana
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a lake or river in the foreground and tree-covered hills in the background. There are small buildings on the hills. Foliage, branches, and a tree stump are near the water's edge. A large leafless tree trunk is on the right side of the image, framing the scene. The color palette is mostly sepia.

artworks.title: The Immaculate Conception
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene. The drawing depicts a central figure holding an infant and a crozier, standing upon a cloud, surrounded by cherubic figures, angels, and dynamic clouds. Above the central figure, rays of light emanate from a triangle that contains Hebrew script. The figures below are in various forms of motion, some with musical instruments, others in adoration or action against dark, swirling clouds. The use of lines and shading creates a sense of depth and movement, emphasizing the spiritual and ethereal nature of the scene.

artworks.title: Iconografica Rappresentatione della Inclita Città di Venezia (Iconongraphic Representation of the Illustrious City of Venice)
artworks.artist: Sebastiano Ricci, Lodovico Ughi, Giovanni Antonio Faldoni for the map, with Francesco Zucchi (mostly after Luca Carlevariis) for the views
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on twenty joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 148.5 x 264.2 cm (58 7/16 x 104 in.) (measured through frame)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a map of Venice. The map shows the layout of the city with canals, streets, and buildings. It has a dedication to the city's rule at the top, a compass rose, and decorative border elements. The central map is surrounded by vignettes of various views or iconic buildings in Venice. A cartouche with allegorical figures is at the top right, and detailed explanations are at the bottom. The drawing is monochromatic, suggesting it is an etching or engraving, possibly from the 17th or 18th century.

artworks.title: Two Ancient Trees before a Mountain Peak
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a large tree with sprawling branches and leaves taking up most of the canvas. Towards the top half, the horizon is visible meeting the sky, with faint outlines of mountains and distant trees in the background. The artist uses delicate brushstrokes to create texture in the foliage, resulting in a full and dynamic appearance. The color scheme consists mainly of green and brown tones, with touches of blue in the leaves and sky, creating a calm and natural atmosphere.

artworks.title: Marée Basse (Low Tide)
artworks.medium: lithographic mezzotint on chine appliqué
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Indiana University Alumni Association
artworks.description: This image depicts a seascape featuring a shoreline with boats on the sand. The horizon is low, emphasizing the dramatic sky with swirling clouds and a monochromatic color scheme of gray, black, and white. The sea is choppy, and the technique used effectively captures the texture of the water and clouds.

artworks.title: Soleil couchant, port d'Anvers (Sunset, Port of Antwerp)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor view with boats, water, and a skyline. The horizon is centered, with the sun above it, reflecting on the water. Two tall-masted ships are present, detailed against the sky. The artwork features expressive linework and a textured sky with clouds. The color scheme is monochrome, with sepia and black tones. A rowboat with two figures is in the foreground, while buildings with spires are seen in the distance.

artworks.title: Narcissus
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 40.8 x 28.2 cm (16 1/16 x 11 1/8 in.) (cut to platemark)
artworks.description: The image shows a man leaning over water with one foot on land and the other extended for balance. He has curly hair and is unclothed, displaying a muscular figure. Above him, a cupid-like figure with wings aims an arrow downward. A dog stands beside the man. In the background, there is dense foliage and shadows, with another couple engaged in conversation in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Capriccio with Ruins and an Obelisk
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of classical ruins. The structures appear slightly elevated to the left. The horizon line is not visible. The brushstrokes are delicate and create intricate details on the ruins, emphasizing texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on a beige background. The etching features fallen rubble, vegetation, columns, an obelisk, and an archway. In the background, the details fade, showing the ruins stretching into the distance.
